description: Add the create-mode popup (Option 2, no draft DB record) to the templates and landing-pages list pages, with a sessionStorage handoff that carries AI-generated HTML into the create page without persisting anything until Save. Add the modal CSS to globals.css. Depends on FEAT-002 (the create pages read the sessionStorage handoff key seeded by this popup) and FEAT-001 (generation path).
steps: Create src/components/create-resource-dialog.tsx ('use client'). Props: { kind: 'landing'|'template'; createHref: string; label: string }. Render a .button.primary trigger (Plus icon + label). On click open a modal: a backdrop element (role/button for click-to-close) plus a dialog panel (role="dialog" aria-modal="true", a labelled heading, a close X button). Support Escape-to-close and backdrop-click-to-close; move focus to the panel/close button on open. Use useRouter from next/navigation.

In the dialog, show two choices initially: 'Create blank' and 'Create with AI'. 'Create blank' => router.push(createHref) and close (no sessionStorage key written, so the create page shows its starter). 'Create with AI' => expand the panel IN PLACE (do not navigate yet) to reveal a reference-image file input with .ai-files removable chips, a prompt textarea, and a Generate button, plus inline .auth-message error and a loading state.

Implement the AI generate submit in the dialog: map kind to the API kind (landing->'landing', template->'email'); POST FormData (prompt, kind, files) to /api/generate-content FROM SCRATCH (no currentHtml). On success, write JSON.stringify({ html: data.html }) to sessionStorage under the exact key the create pages read: 'phishsafe:create-handoff:landing' for landing kind and 'phishsafe:create-handoff:template' for template kind. Then router.push(createHref) and close. On error set the inline error and stay open. NOTHING is written to the database here.

Update src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/create/page.tsx and src/app/dashboard/templates/create/page.tsx (already touched in FEAT-002) to read their handoff key once on mount via a useEffect: if sessionStorage has the key, parse it, seed the html/bodyHtml state, switch the AiHtmlEditor to preview (pass an initialTab or seed via state), then sessionStorage.removeItem(key) so a refresh reverts to starter. Confirm FEAT-002 left a clean seam for this (e.g. the create page owns html state and can set it). If AiHtmlEditor needs an optional initialTab prop to open on preview, add it.

Add an optional `createSlot?: React.ReactNode` prop to src/components/resource-library.tsx. When createSlot is provided, render it instead of the header create <Link> (and instead of the empty-state create <Link> CTA); when absent, keep today's <Link href={createHref}>. Keep createHref/createLabel props (still used as the dialog's createHref/label and as the audiences fallback).

In src/app/dashboard/templates/page.tsx pass createSlot={<CreateResourceDialog kind="template" createHref="/dashboard/templates/create" label="New template" />}; in src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/page.tsx pass createSlot={<CreateResourceDialog kind="landing" createHref="/dashboard/landing-pages/create" label="New landing page" />}. Leave the audiences list page (if any) using the plain link (no slot).

Add modal styling to src/app/globals.css using existing CSS variables for dark-mode compatibility (--surface, --line, --ink, --subtle, --signal): e.g. .create-modal-backdrop (fixed inset-0, dim + blur, high z-index), .create-modal (centered panel on var(--surface)/var(--line), rounded, shadow, max-width), .create-modal-head, .create-modal-choices (the two option buttons), and the expand region. Reuse .field/.ai-files/.ai-generate/.auth-message for the AI sub-form. Do NOT use Tailwind utilities. Add a .dark override only where a hardcoded color needs it.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run lint && npm run build` pass clean.
Templates and landing-pages list pages render the CreateResourceDialog trigger in place of the old direct create link; the audiences list is unchanged.
'Create blank' navigates to the create page showing starter content (no sessionStorage key, nothing persisted).
'Create with AI' generates from scratch, stores the HTML in sessionStorage, navigates to the create page which loads that HTML into the editor on Preview, unsaved, then clears the key.
No draft/DB record is created at any point before the user clicks Save; no redirect to an [id]/edit page for new items.
Modal is accessible (close button + backdrop close + Escape) and readable in both light and dark mode.
verification: Run `npm run lint && npm run build`; confirm clean.
Read create-resource-dialog.tsx to confirm it writes only to sessionStorage (no fetch to a save endpoint / no server action) before navigating, and that keys match what the create pages read.
Read resource-library.tsx to confirm createSlot renders instead of the link when provided and the audiences path still uses the plain link.

Record 'needs runtime verification' in findings: open each list, exercise blank + create-with-AI, confirm the create page shows generated HTML unsaved and a refresh reverts to starter; confirm Escape/backdrop/close and dark-mode rendering.
findings:
DONE. `npm run lint && npm run build` both pass clean.

NEW COMPONENT: src/components/create-resource-dialog.tsx (default export `CreateResourceDialog`, 'use client').
Props: { kind: 'landing' | 'template'; createHref: string; label: string }.
- Trigger is a .button.primary (Plus icon + label). Click opens a modal: .create-modal-backdrop (role="button", backdrop click closes) wrapping .create-modal (role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="create-modal-title"); panel click stops propagation. Escape closes via a document keydown listener added while open; focus moves to the close (X) button on open (closeRef.current.focus()).
- Two initial choices (.create-modal-choices): 'Create blank' => closeDialog() + router.push(createHref) with NO sessionStorage written (create page shows its starter). 'Create with AI' => setMode('ai'), expands IN PLACE (no navigation) to reveal reference-image file input (accept image/*, multiple) with removable .ai-files chips, a prompt textarea, inline .auth-message error, and Back + Generate buttons.
- AI submit: apiKind = kind==='landing' ? 'landing' : 'email'. Builds FormData(prompt, kind=apiKind, each file under 'files') — NO currentHtml (from scratch). POST /api/generate-content. On success writes sessionStorage[ handoffKeys[kind] ] = JSON.stringify({ html: data.html }) then router.push(createHref); on error sets inline error and stays open. NOTHING is written to the DB / no server action here (verified: only fetch to /api/generate-content + sessionStorage.setItem).

HANDOFF KEYS (exact, match create-page readers): landing -> 'phishsafe:create-handoff:landing'; template -> 'phishsafe:create-handoff:template'.

resource-library.tsx: added optional `createSlot?: React.ReactNode`. In BOTH the header and the empty-state CTA, renders `{createSlot ?? <Link href={createHref} .../>}`. When absent (audiences list) the plain <Link> is kept unchanged. createHref/createLabel props retained.

LIST PAGES wired:
- src/app/dashboard/templates/page.tsx: createSlot={<CreateResourceDialog kind="template" createHref="/dashboard/templates/create" label="New template" />}.
- src/app/dashboard/landing-pages/page.tsx: createSlot={<CreateResourceDialog kind="landing" createHref="/dashboard/landing-pages/create" label="New landing page" />}.
- Audiences list (src/app/dashboard/groups/*) NOT touched — still uses the plain link fallback.

CREATE PAGES read+clear the handoff:
- landing-pages/create/page.tsx and templates/create/page.tsx each got a module-level readHandoff() helper: guards typeof window==='undefined' (SSR -> null), reads sessionStorage, immediately sessionStorage.removeItem(key), JSON.parse -> returns html string or null.
- Consumed via a LAZY useState initializer: const [handoffHtml] = useState(readHandoff); const [html,setHtml] = useState(handoffHtml ?? starter); const initialTab = handoffHtml ? 'preview' : 'code', passed to <AiHtmlEditor initialTab={initialTab} />. Used a lazy initializer (not useEffect) because the eslint rule react-hooks/set-state-in-effect forbids synchronous setState in an effect body; the lazy initializer reads+clears once at mount and seeds html so AiHtmlEditor (which only reads initialTab in its own useState at mount) opens on Preview. Removing the key means a refresh reverts to starter.
- Both create pages are dynamic (ƒ server-rendered on demand per build output), so SSR always renders starter (window undefined) and no static-prerender hydration mismatch exists; the handoff is read on the client render after router.push.

MODAL CSS added to src/app/globals.css (after the .dark .landing-ai overrides, before @media): .create-modal-backdrop (fixed inset:0, z-index:120, rgba dim + blur), .create-modal (var(--surface)/var(--line), rounded, shadow, max-width min(480px,100%), scrollable), .create-modal-head/-close, .create-modal-choices (two option buttons using --signal-strong accent), .create-modal-ai (.field/.ai-files/.auth-message reused), .create-modal-actions, plus a .dark .create-modal-close:hover override. All built from existing CSS variables (--surface,--line,--ink,--subtle,--signal-strong); NO Tailwind utilities. Backdrop/panel reuse the existing menu-in keyframes.

NOTHING persists to the DB before Save; no [id]/edit redirect for new items (dialog only navigates to the create route).

NEEDS RUNTIME VERIFICATION (not run here; AI path needs DASHSCOPE_API_KEY + live endpoint): on each list page open the dialog, 'Create blank' -> create page shows starter (nothing stored); 'Create with AI' -> generates, navigates, create page shows generated HTML on Preview unsaved, and a hard refresh reverts to starter (key cleared); Escape, backdrop click, and the X all close; modal is readable in light and dark mode.
